# The Romanian Lawyers

> Atrium Romanian Law Office provides comprehensive legal services across corporate, tech, employment, property, and litigation matters for businesses and individuals in Romania.

Atrium is a full-service Romanian law firm based in Bucharest specializing in corporate law, technology and digital services, data protection compliance, and business formation. The firm serves startups, tech companies, and international clients navigating Romanian and EU legal requirements.
